text: おっと　みちくさ　くってる　ばあい　じゃ　ないぜ！

structure.jp: みちくさ　くってる
ばあい　じゃ　ないぜ！
structure.en: this is no time for that!

patterns.name: 〜ばあいではない
patterns.span: くってる　ばあい　じゃ　ないぜ
patterns.explanation: A verb plus ばあいじゃない says 'this is no time to be doing that'. じゃない is the casual form of ではない. みちくさ くってる ばあい じゃ ない = 'this is no time to be dawdling'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says something is going on right now, and in speech it shrinks to てる. くってる = 'am eating', here as part of the saying for dawdling.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, cocky boys' talk that pushes the statement at the listener. じゃ ないぜ = 'it sure isn't!'
